calls.statement:
SELECT 
    s.format,
    ROUND(AVG(receipt_total), 2) AS average_basket_value
FROM (
    SELECT 
        f.receipt_id,
        f.store_key,
        SUM(f.gross_amount) AS receipt_total
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    WHERE f.sale_date >= '2026-08-03' 
      AND f.sale_date <= '2026-08-30'
    GROUP BY f.receipt_id, f.store_key
) transaction_totals
JOIN dim_store s ON transaction_totals.store_key = s.store_key
GROUP BY s.format
ORDER BY s.format

    COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS transactions,
    ROUND(AVG(receipt_total), 2) AS average_basket_value
FROM (
    SELECT 
        f.receipt_id,
        f.store_key,
        f.sale_date,
        SUM(f.gross_amount) AS receipt_total
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    WHERE f.sale_date >= '2026-08-03'

) transaction_totals

calls.statement:
SELECT 
    s.format,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN t.receipt_total < 0 THEN 1 END) AS negative_transactions,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN t.receipt_total = 0 THEN 1 END) AS zero_transactions,
    MIN(t.receipt_total) AS min_receipt_value,
    MAX(t.receipt_total) AS max_receipt_value
FROM (
    SELECT 
        f.receipt_id,
        f.store_key,
        f.sale_date,
        SUM(f.gross_amount) AS receipt_total
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    WHERE f.sale_date >= '2026-08-03' 
      AND f.sale_date <= '2026-08-30'
    GROUP BY f.receipt_id, f.store_key, f.sale_date
) t
JOIN dim_store s ON t.store_key = s.store_key
    AND t.sale_date >= s.valid_from
    AND t.sale_date <= s.valid_to
GROUP BY s.format
ORDER BY s.format
